extract_json_from_text: extract JSON from a markdown code block and optionally map it to a Python dataclass
render_jinja2_template: render a Jinja2 template string with keyword arguments and environment variables
get_ray_actor_class: dynamically import and return a Ray actor class from a dotted target path string
setup_logging: configure Python logging with debug or info level and a standard log format
send_ray_method_with_retry: call a Ray remote method with configurable timeout and automatic retry on actor errors
